name: HP Teradici PCoIP
description: The remote display protocol built for VFX, CAD, and media/entertainment workstation workloads, now sold by HP as "Anyware" (formerly Teradici Cloud Access Software). Prioritizes bit-exact color accuracy and build-to-lossless image quality over raw compression, with both software clients and dedicated PCoIP hardware "Zero Clients."

4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling.comment: PCoIP Ultra supports "build-to-lossless" bit-exact color; 4:2:0 is only used as an optional bandwidth-saving trade-off

Drawing Tablet Support.comment: Explicitly supports tablet pressure sensitivity — notably rare among the other tools in this table

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: PCoIP Ultra with GPU Offload targets the highest possible frame rates for motion content

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: Core to PCoIP's original design for staying usable over constrained WAN links

H.264 Codec.comment: Including hardware-decode support on supported Windows/Linux clients

Multi-User Sessions.comment: Primarily 1:1 VDI/workstation access; multi-session scenarios depend on the broader deployment architecture

Pre-Login Access.comment: Users authenticate through a connection manager/broker first, then reach the actual workstation session

No Account Required.comment: Requires a licensed HP Anyware deployment with connection manager authentication

2FA / MFA.comment: Supported at the connection manager/identity provider level rather than being a PCoIP protocol feature itself

macOS: Host.comment: PCoIP Agents can run in Windows, Linux, or macOS host environments, including workstations and VMs

Linux X11: Host.comment: Well-documented Graphics Agent support for Linux workstations

Web Browser: Client.comment: Native software clients or dedicated PCoIP Zero Client hardware only; not browser-based

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: Targets datacenter/professional GPU virtualization (NVIDIA vDWS/GRID on Quadro/Tesla-class cards), not consumer GeForce cards

Personal: Monthly.comment: Enterprise/professional workstation product, not sold to individuals

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Sold as annual per-agent subscriptions through resellers, not a self-serve monthly price

Team / Business: Annual.comment: Per-agent annual subscription (e.g. PCoIP Graphics Agent), quoted through HP/Teradici resellers

Enterprise.comment: Used by government, media, and design organizations with top-secret-grade security requirements
